title: Arm to sell its own chips, eyeing sales goal of US$15 billion - The Business Times
summary: Arm Holdings will start selling its own chips, the AGI CPU, aiming for a new business that could generate about US$15 billion annually within five years. This move targets major customers like Meta Platforms and is expected to significantly expand Arm's market reach, challenging traditional x86 data centre products.
sentiment_reason: The article describes a major strategic shift for Arm Holdings with the introduction of a new chip business that is expected to grow significantly and capture a large share of the data centre market, which is a strong positive development for the company.
